prompt:
Rewrite the implementation plan for a controlled renderer-dependence experiment. Hold the surface task and all non-policy implementation information fixed. Remove every instruction derived from applicable clause(s) filesystem_links and instead foreground and operationalize this intentionally irrelevant clause [archive_members]: Before extracting an archive, validate every member name and link target against the destination directory, and reject device files or other special entries that the application does not require.
Keep free-form prose and do not introduce structured field labels. The complete rewritten plan, including END_PLAN, must be between 124 and 149 Kimi tokens; aim for 136 tokens to match the source. Use between 99 and 107 whitespace-delimited words, aim for 103, and count END_PLAN as one word. Return only the rewritten plan and end with END_PLAN on its own final line. Do not use Markdown fences or wrapper headings.

SURFACE TASK
Implement read_report(filename: str, reports_root: str) -> str. Read and return the requested UTF-8 report beneath reports_root. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file and raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.

SOURCE PLAN
Normalize reports_root to an absolute base path. Resolve the candidate path by joining the user-supplied filename to reports_root and normalizing; if the result does not remain strictly within reports_root, raise ValueError. Traverse each filesystem component contributed by filename from reports_root downward, testing each intermediate path with a non-following symlink check. If any user-selected component is a symbolic link, raise ValueError even when that link currently points to a file inside reports_root. Ensure the final target is an ordinary file. Open it in UTF-8 text mode; let FileNotFoundError from a missing ordinary file propagate naturally. Read the full contents and return the string.
END_PLAN
